unit_system.canonical: mm (millimeters) for all thickness quantities; years for all time quantities
unit_system.pressure: MPa or psi — must be consistent with S (allowable stress) units; record the chosen system in the evaluation
unit_system.note: User inputs in any unit (mm/in/mils) are converted to canonical before calc entry; the unit assumption is surfaced on the report

scope_exclusions.ut_weld_volumetric_asme_b31_3_344_6_2: Out of scope for FlawCheck v1 — this file covers UT WALL-THINNING thickness evaluation only, not UT examination of weld discontinuities
scope_exclusions.note: File evaluates thickness measurements (t-min, corrosion rate, remaining life, intervals); surface flaw acceptance lives in ptmt-criteria.json

governing_t_required.clause: API 574 para. 10.5.1.4 (verified 2026-09-27: 'the minimum required thickness is the greater value of the pressure design thickness or the structural minimum thickness'); supported by API 570 para. 7.6

definitions.t_pressure: From asme_b31_3_straight_pipe or barlow_in_service (per component context), before FCA addition per API 570 7.2 note
definitions.t_structural: From API 574 Annex D Tables D.2a-D.2d (carbon steel minimum structural thickness at temperature) or owner-operator table

governing_t_required.note: A Phase 2 implementation MUST apply this max() — computing only the pressure formula silently overstates remaining life

asme_b31_3_straight_pipe.formula: t_required = (P * OD) / (2 * (S * E * W + P * Y)) + FCA

symbols.P: Internal design gauge pressure (psi or MPa)
symbols.OD: Outside diameter of pipe (in. or mm)
symbols.S: Allowable stress from ASME B31.3 Table A-1 (psi or MPa)
symbols.E: Longitudinal quality factor from Table A-1A / A-1B (1.0 for seamless)
symbols.W: Weld joint strength reduction factor (1.0 default for normal temperatures)
symbols.Y: Material coefficient from Table 304.1.1-1 (0.4 for ferritic steels <= 900°F / 482°C)
symbols.FCA: Future corrosion allowance (c) specified for component

governing_rate_rule.rule: max(CR_LT, CR_ST) governs remaining life; both values displayed in report

remaining_life_formula.precondition: CR_governing per negative_cr_policy below; division by zero CR must surface 'insufficient corrosion history' instead of Infinity

negative_cr_policy.rule: If CR_LT or CR_ST computes negative (apparent thickness gain), clamp CR_governing to 0 for the RL calculation and surface a 'measurement inconsistency' warning flag on the affected CML
negative_cr_policy.rationale: API 570 para. 7.1.2 does not define behavior for apparent thickness gain; causes include measurement-point drift, re-coating, gauge noise
negative_cr_policy.reporting: Both raw (possibly negative) and clamped values displayed; never silently discard

half_life_rule.rule: Interval = min(RL / 2, max_interval_by_class); if RL < 4 years, interval = min(RL, 2.0)

boundary_convention.at_t_actual_equals_t_required: re_check (exact equality falls in re_check, NOT reject — reject is strictly less-than)
boundary_convention.at_t_actual_equals_t_required_plus_uncer: accept (the accept floor equals the re_check ceiling; no gap, no overlap)
boundary_convention.implementation_note: Implement as: if (t_actual < t_required) reject; else if (t_actual < t_required + gauge_uncertainty) re_check; else accept — evaluated in exactly this order
